faq_q1: How much does a project cost?
faq_a1: Pricing depends on project scope: Landing pages start from 500,000 UZS, Telegram bots from 400,000 UZS, corporate websites from 2,000,000 UZS, and AI automation from 1,200,000 UZS. We provide a detailed estimate during your free consultation.
faq_a2: Average timelines: Telegram bot — 3–10 days, landing page — 5–7 days, corporate portal — 2–4 weeks, AI chatbot — 1–3 weeks. Exact timeline is defined in technical scope.
faq_q3: Is technical support provided after delivery?
faq_a3: Yes. Every project includes a 1-month free warranty (hosting and bug fixes). Monthly maintenance contracts are also available.
faq_a4: Local: Payme, Click, Uzum Bank, Apelsin. International: Stripe, PayPal. Full integration with bots and websites, including webhooks and admin panel control.
